$comment: Flasks enemies carry and throw at the heroes (src/data/stats.json `throwables`; systems/ThrowSystem.ts), after the D&D 5e Player's Handbook and Baldur's Gate 3. rangeFeet: how far one is thrown. radiusFeet: how wide it splashes where it lands. save and dc: the saving throw everyone in the splash makes. damage and damageType: what the splash deals on a failed save (none on a success). burnSeconds: how long a body that failed burns, taking burnDamage each round (6 s; standing in water puts it out). surface: what it leaves on the floor (systems/Surfaces.ts), surfaceSeconds how long that lasts (0: for good) and surfaceDc the save it asks of whoever enters it (grease: DEX or fall prone). Fire sets grease alight.
